stem.text: Some gas in a cylinder is supplied with thermal energy $q$.
The gas does useful work in expanding at constant pressure $p$ from volume $V_0$ to volume $V_\text{F}$, as shown.

stem.alt: Pictorial diagram of a cylinder with a piston, showing a gas region labelled gas pressure p, a dashed outline of the piston at an earlier position, and brackets labelled volume V_0 and volume V_F.

stem.text: Which expression gives the efficiency of this process?
